mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reconditioned Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol (P525) engine typically costs between £5,500 and £9,000 for supply only, with fully rebuilt options ranging from £8,000 to £12,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of supercharger failure in a Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning sign is a distinct rattling or whining noise from the front of the engine, particularly at idle or low RPMs.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the strong retained value of the L663 Defender 110 V8 (typically £80,000-£110,000+), a rebuild is highly financially viable.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol engine replacement take?

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade my Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol cooling system during replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many specialists recommend upgrading to revised aluminium coolant crossover pipes and an improved supercharger coupler during a P525 replacement.

problems.h4: Supercharger Coupler & Cooling Leaks - Why the Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Petrol P525 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: The supercharger snout coupler can wear over time, causing a rattling noise, while plastic coolant crossover pipes are prone to developing leaks due to heat cycling in the V-engine valley.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the supercharger coupler and upgrading to revised aluminium coolant crossover pipes.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly effective preventative measure if caught before secondary overheating damage occurs.
